[View PDF](/pdf/1804.07177) [HTML
(experimental)](https://arxiv.org/html/1804.07177v1)

> Abstract:Reliable identification of bird species in recorded audio
> files would be a transformative tool for researchers, conservation
> biologists, and birders. In recent years, artificial neural networks
> have greatly improved the detection quality of machine learning
> systems for bird species recognition. We present a baseline system
> using convolutional neural networks. We publish our code base as
> reference for participants in the 2018 LifeCLEF bird identification
> task and discuss our experiments and potential improvements.
